title: Heirloom quality
body: This is the kind of saree you pass down. The ikat work is flawless and the colour is so rich. Worth every rupee.

title: Absolutely radiant
body: The green and gold together are magical under light. Lightweight, easy to carry all evening, and the zari border is gorgeous.

title: My new favourite
body: So soft and airy. Perfect for a daytime function. The peach shade is exactly like the photos — delicate and elegant.

title: Stitched to perfection
body: The suit set fit beautifully and the colour combination is regal. Sutaara’s finishing is top-notch.

title: Wearable art
body: Every motif tells a story. I have never owned anything with this much detail. Felt special the moment I put it on.

title: Elegant beyond words
body: Received it well-packed and on time. The rose and emerald pairing is stunning and the fabric feels premium.

title: A dream to drape
body: The hand-painted peacocks are even more stunning in person. I wore it to my sister’s wedding and could not stop getting compliments. You can feel the craft in every inch.
